For this first S05 delivery, do not fix the defect. Inspect the actual repository and produce a Development Result revision 1 identifying the candidate commit, repository URL, baseline, branch/scope, tests or checks run, and any known risk. Leave the issue in_review after delivery. Include exact evidence refs in the comment and do not claim Verification Result or PASS.

The purpose is to give S06 a real r1 artifact to independently reproduce. A comment alone is not the acceptance predicate; include exact commit evidence.
